$$27 - 5 = 22 \text{ years old}$$

$$2 \times 30 - 5 = 55 \text{ years old}$$

**Cousin's current age:**
$$55 - 8 = 47 \text{ years old}$$

**Age difference now:**
$$47 - 22 = 25 \text{ years}$$

**Check:** In 8 years, Jame is 30 and cousin is 55. Twice 30 is 60, and 55 is indeed 5 less than 60. ✓

ANSWER: 25
